result: Added ForwardPaperSessionService requiring a durable explicit preflight, then running the forward coordinator and idempotently reconciling receipts into the existing PaperAccount OMS and double-entry ledger. Stable fill IDs, effective-dated fee accounting, order state, cash, position, realized P&L, and available conservative unrealized marks are captured. Local mock integration demonstrates restart-safe reconciliation.
focused_tests: 50 passed across account bridge, PaperAccount, forward runner and intraday integrations; Ruff, mypy, inventory freshness and diff checks passed
blockers: No authorized Kite live-market session has yet been captured. The current daily access token is unavailable in this environment; real session evidence requires the owner login and an eligible market session.
limitations: This bridge covers long-only INR cash-equity paper accounts. Derivatives margin, short inventory, settlement cycles and options exercise remain out of scope.
Local tests use synthetic quotes and do not establish live capture, profitability or slippage fidelity.
